name: Laundry & Garment Care
shortDescription: Hand-finished laundering, pressing and preservation for tailored and delicate garments.
highlights: Wet-cleaning and dry-cleaning for suits, gowns and traditional wear
Stain treatment for silk, lace, brocade and embroidery
Seasonal storage preparation and garment bags
body: A well-made garment only stays well-made if it's cared for properly. Our laundry service is built around the same fabrics we cut every day — so we know exactly how a raw silk gown or a wool-blend suit needs to be handled.
Every item is inspected on arrival, cleaned with the gentlest method suited to its fabric, and hand-pressed rather than machine-pressed to protect stitching and structure.
Ask about our care plans for garments we've tailored for you — repeat clients get priority turnaround.
